svg.title: Two group risks, two effect scales
svg.desc: Two 100-symbol grids show expected five-year recurrence or death counts of 20 with control and 14 with a new strategy. The difference is six per hundred, the relative reduction is six divided by twenty, and the horizon-specific number needed to treat rounds to seventeen.
svg.text: 6 fewer events per 100 at five years
An average contrast, not who benefits.
